name: sonos-nfc
description: Use NFC tags to control Sonos - a node app inspired by and compatible with hankhank10/vinylemulator, with better NFC reader compatibility

scripts.preinstall: node -e "if (+process.versions.node.split('.')[0] < 24) { console.error('\n\u001b[31mThis project requires Node 24+. You are running ' + process.version + '.\u001b[0m\n'); process.exit(1); }"

author: Cody Bromley
